{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace DagReduction

def edge (mask n u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < n ∧ v < n ∧ ((mask / (2 ^ (u * n + v))) % 2 = 1)

def path (mask n : Nat) (u v length : Nat) : Prop :=
  match length with
  | 0 => u = v
  | k + 1 => ∃ w, w < n ∧ edge mask n u w ∧ path mask n w v k

def cyclic (mask n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ v length, v < n ∧ 1 ≤ length ∧ length ≤ n ∧ path mask n v v length

def alternate (mask n u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ length, 2 ≤ length ∧ length ≤ n ∧ path mask n u v length

def retained (mask n u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  edge mask n u v ∧ ¬ alternate mask n u v

def output (mask n : Nat) : Except Unit Nat :=
  if cyclic mask n then Except.error () else Except.ok mask

def valid (mask n : Nat) : Prop :=
  n ≤ 10 ∧ mask < 2 ^ (n * n)

def acyclic (mask n : Nat) : Prop := ¬ cyclic mask n

def reachable (mask n u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ length, length ≤ n ∧ path mask n u v length

def reducedReachable (mask n u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ length, length ≤ n ∧
    (match length with
     | 0 => u = v
     | k + 1 => ∃ w, w < n ∧ retained mask n u w ∧ path mask n w v k)

theorem O1 (mask n : Nat) (h : valid mask n) :
    cyclic mask n → output mask n = Except.error () := by sorry

theorem O2 (mask n u v : Nat) (h : valid mask n) (ha : acyclic mask n) :
    edge mask n u v → (retained mask n u v ↔ ¬ alternate mask n u v) := by sorry

theorem O3 (mask n u v : Nat) (h : valid mask n) (ha : acyclic mask n) :
    reachable mask n u v ↔ reducedReachable mask n u v := by sorry

theorem O5 (mask n : Nat) (h : valid mask n) :
    cyclic mask n ∨ (acyclic mask n ∧ ∃ result, output mask n = Except.ok result) := by sorry

theorem O4 (mask n : Nat) :
    output mask n = output mask n := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
    (∃ mask n, valid mask n ∧ acyclic mask n) ∧
    (∃ mask n, valid mask n ∧ cyclic mask n) := by sorry
